description: Create a balance top-up checkout link (Stripe card or crypto USDC) for the authenticated account.

amount_mad.description: Custom recharge amount in MAD (minimum 300 MAD). Optional if pack_id is provided.

currency.description: Payment presentation currency for card checkout ('mad' or 'eur'). Default 'mad'.

pack_id.description: SMS top-up pack ID (e.g. 'sms-300' for 300 MAD, 'sms-1000' for 1000 MAD, 'sms-5000' for 5000 MAD). Optional if amount_mad is provided.

payment_method.description: Payment method ('stripe' for card or 'crypto' for USDC). Default 'stripe'.

name: create_topup
